description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

An early-stage software company is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build the core platform behind an automation product and its user-facing experience. The role spans backend, data and frontend work, taking features from initial ideas through release while working closely with users.
Full-stack product engineer building secure data systems, integrations, APIs, and customer-facing dashboards

Responsibilities:
• Ship user-facing functionality from early idea to live release, speaking with users, shaping the approach and watching real usage
• Model data securely with strong audit trails and build event-driven processing pipelines
• Create service interfaces for internal and external use, plus a live web dashboard that gives customers clear visibility
• Connect the platform to third-party business systems and partners, and maintain a dependable data synchronization layer
• Put monitoring, reliability targets and on-call routines in place for business-critical processes
• Move across backend, data and frontend work depending on where effort pays off most

Requirements:
• Sound product instincts, with a habit of improving things from user feedback and a high standard for interface design and usability
• Self-directed approach to delivering complete features with little supervision
• Degree in computer science or a related technical discipline from a well-regarded university
• Background at a B2B or B2C SaaS startup that cares about product quality
• Prior experience in a very small startup environment
• If you have roughly 1 to 2 years of experience: an internship or role at a leading tech company, a portfolio demonstrating strong product skills, or a degree from a top engineering school
• Enthusiasm for building at an early stage

Preferred:
• Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Postgres
• Familiarity with modern frontend tooling such as Next.js and Tailwind
